name: tau-banking-source-screen-01
selection: Use the pinned native tasks/task_*.json files. Keep all previously assigned tasks out of development. Reserve all 11 new previously identified base-DB customers and their 16 tasks; quarantine other tasks mentioning a reserved ID or full customer name. Use remaining DB or ACTION tasks starting with a fresh native greeting; exclude NL assertion grading. An unverified persona is not an independent customer.
unit: One task with three fresh no-memory first passes at the same native and worker seed. The three sampled dialogues may differ. Score all registered tasks and report missing allocations. Confirmation tasks receive no requests.
primary: A development candidate has three official grades, both success and failure, and at least one graded trajectory with a task-tagged document ID returned by native grep in the writer-visible public experience and absent from that trajectory's complete first worker request. A positive sighting is sufficient even if another search could not be parsed; negative requires complete coverage.
interpretation: This identifies candidate judgments for subsequent comparisons. A document ID is a retrieval opportunity. The screen measures neither memory use nor a causal change in final success. Report observed all-failure and all-success tasks, incomplete tasks, candidate identity coverage, public evidence pointers, total tokens, confirmed and held cost.
interruption: Resume only allocations that have not started under the same registration. Seal submitted errors and reserve wire-specific maxima on recognized unpriced transport failures under the inherited cost policy. No outcome-driven replacement.
